request: Analyze GSE309619 for PMID 41831133 (Resistance-based exercise restores muscle health in dialysis patients.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk polyA mRNA-seq, NovaSeq X Plus PE150, human forearm flexor skeletal muscle (S2.2.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Within-patient change in skeletal-muscle gene expression after 12 months of personalized resistance-based muscle therapy versus baseline in dialysis patients (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1)

factors.subject: patients GHD28, GHD35, GHD42, GHD45, GHD58

final.sample_inclusion: Only patients who consented to the optional biopsy (S2.1.3.p1); RNA-seq n = 5 patients x 2 visits (FIG1, FIG4 legend)
final.repeated_measure_unit: patient (pre/post paired biopsies); GEO deposits 2 libraries per patient-visit (B/C or A/C)
planned_contrasts: Visit-2 (post 12 mo exercise) vs Visit-1 (baseline), paired by patient (S3.1.p1, FIG1, FIG4; paper reports no DEG count)

paper_threshold.note: No DEG threshold stated. RNA-seq was analysed on the vendor NovoMagic platform (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1); the only stated rule is unpaired two-tailed Student's t-test p < 0.05 for IHC/IF quantification (S2.4.p1).

final.paper_method: Vendor (NovoMagic) pipeline, method unstated; GO enrichment of upregulated genes (FIG1); per-gene display of 20 oxidation/energy genes (FIG4A)

go_terms_up: generation of precursor metabolites and energy
energy derivation by oxidation of organic compounds

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Single-arm longitudinal design: 5 dialysis patients biopsied at baseline and after 12 months of resistance-based therapy (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1, FIG4 legend lists EB_28/35/42/45/58 V1/V2). No control arm, so the estimand is a pre/post within-patient change. The paper gives no DEG count or DEG threshold; results are GO terms (FIG1) and a named-gene panel (FIG4A).

checks: GEO series summary matches the paper abstract; contact Ajay Rana (author AR), UIC Surgery
Sample titles Patient GHD28/35/42/45/58 Visit-1/Visit-2 match FIG4 legend (EB_28_V1 ... EB_58_V2)
GSE309619_AR_FPKM.xls.txt.gz is the only supplementary file; data_processing says 'analysis results; AR_FPKM.xls.txt'

ownership.reasoning: Accession, sample labels and contact all belong to this paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix column names sit inside the GEO title in brackets (inspect alignment_keys: 20/20 metadata samples matched). subject and time parsed from the title text 'Patient GHDxx-Visit-y'. Matrix has one extra column (EB_35_V2B) with no GSM record; it is left unmatched.

matrix.stop_reason: The only deposited expression file, GSE309619_AR_FPKM.xls.txt.gz (1,022 bytes on the GEO FTP, confirmed by HTTP Content-Length), contains just 4 genes (ACTA1, CKM, TNNC2, MT-TN) x 21 libraries. A genome-wide pre/post differential-expression analysis cannot be run on 4 features, and none of the paper's 20 named FIG4A genes are present. No raw counts or full FPKM table are deposited (sample supplementary_file = NONE). Unblock by obtaining the complete FPKM/count table from the authors or by re-quantifying the SRA reads (BioSample links in GEO) with an alignment/quantification pipeline, which this workflow does not provide.
matrix.reasoning: Values are decimals 1e4-6e4 (FPKM per data_processing 'AR_FPKM'), so the scale is clear, but the file is a 4-row excerpt of the vendor result table, not a matrix. The design itself (5 patients x pre/post, 2 libraries each) would support a paired exercise comparison; the blocker is the missing full matrix, which a specific file could supply, hence manual_review rather than refused.

candidates.value: Run limma on log2(FPKM+1) of the 4 deposited genes
candidates.reason_rejected: Four features is not a transcriptome; empirical-Bayes moderation and BH correction are meaningless, and the paper's genes are absent.

discrepancies.paper: RNA-seq of muscle from 5 patients at baseline and 12 months, analysed genome-wide (GO enrichment FIG1; 20-gene panel FIG4A)
discrepancies.data: GEO supplementary file holds only 4 genes x 21 libraries; no raw counts

discrepancies.paper: n = 5 (one sample per patient per visit in FIG4 legend)
discrepancies.data: 2 libraries per patient-visit in GEO (20 GSMs); the matrix has a 21st column EB_35_V2B with no GSM

discrepancies.paper: Student's t-test unpaired, two-tailed, p < 0.05 (S2.4.p1) for IHC/IF; RNA-seq method unstated (NovoMagic)
discrepancies.data: pre/post biopsies from the same patients
